source_title: Locked apartment buildings and delivery drivers
post_title: Locked apartment buildings and delivery drivers
post_body:
This is for any state college students. If you live in a locked apartment building dont expect delivery drivers to come to your door

The Maxxen, the rise, the standard, the haus, etc etc. Especially if the elevators require a key to come up stairs. Ive been delivering for close to 6 years in this town. The apartment buildings have the doors locked for a reason and if you go past it they will threaten to trespass the driver.
Also expecting the driver to be let in by someone else and wait for someone to give them an elevator ride up to your floor and back down is ridiculous
I have run into so many very rude students to this year that dont grasp this and go I have always had my uber eats drivers come up this is ridiculous
I know most of the other UE and full time drivers and none of us do.
frrrr. downtown apartment buildings are crazy with their security. im sure it feels hella safe. but what do you want me to do when i dont have a code or anything to let me in
This chick right before this told me to have someone let me in at the Maxxen. Have the person get me to her floor and wait for someone else to get me down. I was like absolutely not.
I always put in my drivers notes that Ill meet them outside and even guide them around the complex since its confusing. Crazy that people are expecting them to get through a locked door, sounds like laziness and inconsideration.
Youre the best type of customer. Ready to meet outside as we pull up. Its great. I will go into a place if they give me a code (plaza Dr apartments specifically) but Ive had multiple people say just follow someone else in and bring it to me
That is crazy entitlement wtf. I worked in the food service industry so I know how it feels and care about these things. I also know yall barely make anything off of it and get overworked so if I can make things easier, I do! And you have a time limit. I live at Aspen so hope you havent had problems there. Most drivers leave the food outside the main door
Ah yeah Ill leave it there or if they ask for a specific door Ill go to it. Good luck working the food industry here in town. I ran restaurants here since 2018 when there was still a Taco Bell downtown. I moved to delivery full time 2 years ago and Im never going back
Im a grad student now which means that Im not in the food industry anymore
but maybe I will be in the future as my degree isnt the most useful lmao. I hope the delivery life is treating you well
The chick that caused this post had a pin. I told her i have 10k plus deliveries and have never had went upstairs in her building. She gave me the pin and said fine leave it there
I was just there about 3 hours later and her food was still there. I got tipped already so I now have dinner
Yeah that's ridiculous. It's not hard to come down to meet your driver at the main door or pick it up shortly after it's been dropped off especially if you are able bodied.
author: manual_import
